{"content":"import io
import socket
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import Mock

from paasio import MeteredFile, MeteredSocket


class MeteredFileTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def make_file(self, data=b""):
        raw = tempfile.TemporaryFile(buffering=0)
        raw.write(data)
        raw.seek(0)
        file = MeteredFile(raw)
        self.addCleanup(file.close)
        return file

    def test_reads_count_actual_bytes_and_empty_operations(self):
        file = self.make_file(b"hello")
        self.assertIsInstance(file, io.BufferedRandom)
        self.assertEqual((file.read_bytes, file.read_ops), (0, 0))
        self.assertEqual(file.read(2), b"he")
        self.assertEqual(file.read(20), b"llo")
        self.assertEqual(file.read(), b"")
        self.assertEqual(file.read(0), b"")
        self.assertEqual((file.read_bytes, file.read_ops), (5, 4))
        self.assertEqual((file.write_bytes, file.write_ops), (0, 0))

    def test_writes_and_reads_have_independent_counters(self):
        file = self.make_file()
        self.assertEqual(file.write(b"hello"), 5)
        self.assertEqual(file.write(memoryview(b" world")), 6)
        self.assertEqual(file.write(b""), 0)
        self.assertEqual((file.write_bytes, file.write_ops), (11, 3))
        file.seek(0)
        self.assertEqual(file.read(), b"hello world")
        self.assertEqual((file.read_bytes, file.read_ops), (11, 1))

    def test_iteration_counts_each_line_once(self):
        file = self.make_file(b"first\n\nlast")
        self.assertIs(iter(file), file)
        self.assertEqual(next(file), b"first\n")
        self.assertEqual(list(file), [b"\n", b"last"])
        self.assertEqual((file.read_bytes, file.read_ops), (11, 3))
        with self.assertRaises(StopIteration):
            next(file)
        self.assertEqual(file.read_ops, 3)

    def test_context_closes_file_and_propagates_errors(self):
        file = self.make_file()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "test error"):
            with file as entered:
                self.assertIs(entered, file)
                file.write(b"x")
                raise ValueError("test error")
        self.assertTrue(file.closed)
        self.assertEqual((file.write_bytes, file.write_ops), (1, 1))

    def test_failed_operations_do_not_change_counters(self):
        file = self.make_file()
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            file.write("not bytes")
        file.close()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            file.read()
        self.assertEqual((file.read_bytes, file.read_ops), (0, 0))
        self.assertEqual((file.write_bytes, file.write_ops), (0, 0))

    def test_statistics_are_read_only_and_per_instance(self):
        first, second = self.make_file(), self.make_file()
        first.write(b"x")
        self.assertEqual(second.write_bytes, 0)
        for name in ("read_bytes", "read_ops", "write_bytes", "write_ops"):
            with self.assertRaises(AttributeError):
                setattr(first, name, 10)


class MeteredSocketTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_partial_and_empty_transfers_and_flags(self):
        raw = Mock()
        raw.recv.side_effect = [b"abc", b""]
        raw.send.side_effect = [2, 0]
        metered = MeteredSocket(raw)
        self.assertEqual((metered.recv_bytes, metered.recv_ops), (0, 0))
        self.assertEqual((metered.send_bytes, metered.send_ops), (0, 0))
        self.assertEqual(metered.recv(10, 7), b"abc")
        raw.recv.assert_called_with(10, 7)
        self.assertEqual(metered.recv(10), b"")
        raw.recv.assert_called_with(10, 0)
        self.assertEqual(metered.send(b"abcdef", 8), 2)
        raw.send.assert_called_with(b"abcdef", 8)
        self.assertEqual(metered.send(b""), 0)
        raw.send.assert_called_with(b"", 0)
        self.assertEqual((metered.recv_bytes, metered.recv_ops), (3, 2))
        self.assertEqual((metered.send_bytes, metered.send_ops), (2, 2))

    def test_failed_operations_do_not_change_counters(self):
        raw = Mock()
        raw.recv.side_effect = OSError("read failed")
        raw.send.side_effect = OSError("write failed")
        metered = MeteredSocket(raw)
        with self.assertRaises(OSError):
            metered.recv(10)
        with self.assertRaises(OSError):
            metered.send(b"data")
        self.assertEqual((metered.recv_bytes, metered.recv_ops), (0, 0))
        self.assertEqual((metered.send_bytes, metered.send_ops), (0, 0))

    def test_real_socket_io_and_context_cleanup(self):
        raw, peer = socket.socketpair()
        self.addCleanup(raw.close)
        self.addCleanup(peer.close)
        raw.settimeout(1)
        peer.settimeout(1)
        metered = MeteredSocket(raw)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "test error"):
            with metered as entered:
                self.assertIs(entered, metered)
                peer.sendall(b"hello")
                self.assertEqual(metered.recv(5), b"hello")
                self.assertEqual(metered.send(b"ok"), 2)
                self.assertEqual(peer.recv(2), b"ok")
                raise ValueError("test error")
        self.assertEqual(raw.fileno(), -1)
        self.assertEqual((metered.recv_bytes, metered.recv_ops), (5, 1))
        self.assertEqual((metered.send_bytes, metered.send_ops), (2, 1))

    def test_statistics_are_read_only_and_per_instance(self):
        raw = Mock()
        raw.send.return_value = 1
        first, second = MeteredSocket(raw), MeteredSocket(Mock())
        first.send(b"x")
        self.assertEqual(second.send_bytes, 0)
        for name in ("recv_bytes", "recv_ops", "send_bytes", "send_ops"):
            with self.assertRaises(AttributeError):
                setattr(first, name, 10)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
